source: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.
reference: Beijing itakuwa mwenyeji wa sherehe za kufungua na kufunga na matukio ya ndani kwenye barafu.
hypothesis: Beijing itakuwa mwenyeji wa sherehe za ufunguzi na kufunga na matukio ya barafu ya ndani.

source: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.
reference: Matukio mengine ya kuteleza kwenye theluji yatakuwa katika eneo la Taizicheng katika Zhangjiakou, takribani kilomita 220 (maili 140) kutoka Beijing.
hypothesis: Matukio mengine ya skiing yatapigwa katika eneo la Taizicheng la skiing huko Zhangjiakou, kilomita 220 (140) kutoka Beijing.

source: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.
reference: Hekalu nyingi zina sikukuu ya Kila mwaka kuanzia mwishoni mwa Novemba hadi katikati mwa Mei, ambayo hufautiana kulingana na kalenda ya mwaka ya kila hekalu.
hypothesis: Wengi wa mahekalu hupata tamasha la kila mwaka kutoka mwisho wa Novemba hadi katikati ya Mei, ambayo hutofautiana kulingana na kalenda ya kila mwaka ya hekalu.

source: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.
reference: Sherehe nyingi za Hekaluni zinaadhimishwa kama sehemu ya maadhimisho ya hekalu au siku ya kuzaliwa kwa mungu anayeongoza au tukio lolote jingine kuu linalohusiana na hekalu.
hypothesis: Zaidi ya sherehe za hekalu zinasherehekwa kama sehemu ya maadhimisho ya kumbukumbu ya hekalu au siku ya kuzaliwa ya mungu mkuu wa hekalu au tukio lolote muhimu zaidi kuhusiana na hekalu.

source: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.
reference: Tamasha za hekalu za Kerala ni za kufurahisha sana kuona, kwa msafara wa mara kwa mara wa ndovu waliopambwa, bendi za hekalu na tamasha nyinginezo.
hypothesis: Matukio ya makanisa ya Kerala ni ya kuvutia sana kuona, na usafiri wa mara kwa mara wa tembo wenye mapambo, orchestra ya hekalu na sherehe nyingine.

source: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
reference: Maonyesho ya Dunia (kwa kawaida yanajulikana kama World Exposition, au Expo tu) ni tamasha kubwa ya kimataifa ya sanaa na sayansi.
hypothesis: Maonyesho ya Dunia (pia hujulikana kama Maonyesho ya Kimataifa, au kwa urahisi Expo) ni tamasha kubwa la kimataifa la sanaa na sayansi.

source: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
reference: Nchi zinazoshiriki huwasilisha maonyesho ya kisanaa na kielimu katika kumbi za kitaifa ili kuonyesha masuala ya kidunia au utamaduni na historia ya nchi yao.
hypothesis: Waliohudhuria nchi zinazopatikana kwa maonyesho ya sanaa na elimu katika majumba ya kitaifa ili kuonyesha masuala ya dunia au utamaduni na historia ya nchi yao.

source: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
reference: Maonyesho ya Kimataifa ya Maua ni matukio maalum ambayo huonyesha maonyesho ya maua, bustani za mimea na kitu chochote kingine kinachohusisha mimea.
hypothesis: Maonyesho ya Kimataifa ya Bustani ni matukio maalum ambayo yanaonyesha maonyesho ya maua, bustani za botani na kitu chochote kingine kuhusiana na mimea.

source: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.
reference: Ingawa katika nadharia zinaweza kutokea kila mwaka (mradi zako katika nchi tofauti), kwa mazoezi hazipo.
hypothesis: Wakati wa kawaida wanaweza kufanyika kila mwaka (hivyo kama ni nchi tofauti), kwa kweli hawafanyiwi.

source: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
reference: Matukio hayo huwa kwa miezi mitatu hadi miezi sita, na hufanyika kwenye maeneo yasiyopungua hekta 50.
hypothesis: Matukio haya kawaida huchukua kati ya miezi mitatu na sita, na hufanyika kwenye maeneo ambayo hayajazwa chini ya hekta 50.

source: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.
reference: Kuna aina nyingi za filamu ambazo zimetumika kwa miaka. Filamu ya milimita 35 (kanda hasi ya milimita 36 kwa milimita 24) ni ya kawaida zaidi.
hypothesis: Kuna aina nyingi za muundo wa filamu ambazo zimekuwa zikitumiwa kwa miaka mingi. Filamu ya kawaida ya 35 mm (36 kwa 24 mm ya picha) ni ya kawaida zaidi.

source: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.
reference: Kwa kawaida inaweza kujazwa tena kwa urahisi kiasi ikiisha, na hutoa ubora wa mwonekano unaoweza kulinganishwa na ule wa DSLR ya sasa.
hypothesis: Inaweza kurejeshwa kwa urahisi kama unapoteza, na inatoa ufumbuzi wa karibu sawa na DSLR ya sasa.

source: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.
reference: Kamera ingine za muundo wa kati zinatumia muundo wa 6 kwa 6, kwa usahihi 56 kwa 56 hasi.
hypothesis: Baadhi ya kamera za filamu za format ya kati hutumia format ya 6 x 6 cm, haswa 56 x 56 mm chini.

source: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
reference: Hii hutoa ubora wa mwonekano karibu mara nne ya ule wa picha hasi ya milimita 35 (3136 mm2 dhidi ya 864).
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, hii inatoa ufumbuzi karibu mara nne ya kiwango cha chini cha 35 mm (3136 mm2 dhidi ya 864).

source: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.
reference: Wanyama pori ni miongoni mwa michoro yenye changamoto zaidi kwa mpiga picha, na inahitaji mchanganyiko wa bahati nzuri, uvumilivu, uzoefu na vifaa vizuri.
hypothesis: Uhai wa wanyama ni miongoni mwa mada zinazokuwa changamoto kwa mtayarishaji wa picha, na inahitaji bahati nzuri, uvumilivu, uzoefu na vifaa vya kutosha.

source: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.
reference: Upigaji picha za wanyamapori mara nyingi huchukuliwa kwa urahisi, lakini kama upigaji picha kwa ujumla, picha ina thamani ya maneno elfu.
hypothesis: Ukuta wa wanyama mara nyingi huchukuliwa kwa kuheshimu, lakini kama picha kwa ujumla, picha ni thamani ya maneno elfu.

source: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.
reference: Mara nyingi upigaji picha za wanyamapori huhitaji lenzi ndefu, ingawa vitu kama kundi la ndege au kiumbe mdogo huhitaji lenzi nyingine.
hypothesis: Ukuta wa wanyama mara nyingi huchukua lensi ya telephoto ndefu, ingawa mambo kama ndege wa kundi au mnyama mdogo wanahitaji lenses nyingine.

source: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.
reference: Ni vigumu kupata wanyama wengi wa kigeni, na mbuga wakati mwingine huwa na sheria zinazohusu upigaji picha kwa ajili za kibiashara.
hypothesis: Wanyama wengi wa ajabu ni vigumu kupatikana, na hata hivyo, mbuga mara nyingi zina sheria kuhusu kuchukua picha kwa madhumuni ya kibiashara.

source: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
reference: Wanyamapori wanaweza kuwa wenye aibu au wakali. Mazingira yanaweza kuwa baridi, joto, au makali kwa vinginevyo.
hypothesis: Wanyama wa asili wanaweza kuwa wanyonge au waovu. Mazingira yanaweza kuwa baridi, joto, au vinginevyo mabaya.

source: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
reference: Ulimwengu una zaidi ya lugha 5,000, zikiwemo zaidi ya ishirini zilizo na wazungumzaji zaidi ya milioni 50.
hypothesis: Ulimwengu una lugha zaidi ya 5,000, ikiwa ni pamoja na zaidi ya ishirini zenye wasemaji zaidi ya milioni 50.

source: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.
reference: Maneno yaliyoandikwa mara nyingi huwa rahisi kuelewa kuliko maneno yaliyotamkwa, pia. Hii huwa hususan ni kweli kwa anwani, ambazo aghalabu huwa vigumu kutamkwa kwa busara.
hypothesis: Maneno yaliyochapishwa mara nyingi ni rahisi kuelewa kuliko maneno yaliyosemwa, pia. Hii ni hasa kweli kwa anuani, ambazo mara nyingi ni vigumu kuzungumza kwa ufasaha.

source: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.
reference: Mataifa mengi mazima huzungumza Kiingereza kwa ufasaha kabisa, na kwa hata mengine mengi unaweza kutarajia ufahamu mdogo - hasa miongoni mwa watu wenye umri mdogo.
hypothesis: Watu wengi wa mataifa yote wanajua lugha ya Kiingereza vizuri, na katika wengine wengi unaweza kutarajia maarifa machache - hasa kwa watu wa umri mdogo.

source: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.
reference: Fikiria, ukitaka, Mmankunia, Mbostonia, Mjamaika, na Msydney wakiwa wameketi wamezunguka meza wakila chajio mkahawani katika Toronto.
hypothesis: Je! Unaweza kufikiria, kama utakuwa na Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican na Sydneysider wakikaa kwenye meza ya chakula cha jioni katika mgahawa huko Toronto?

source: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.
reference: Wanaburudishana na hadithi kutoka kwa mitaa ya manyumbani kwao, inayosemwa katika lafudhi zao tofauti na lugha ya kienyeji isiyo rasmi.
hypothesis: Wao wanawasiliana kwa hadithi kutoka kwa majiji yao, zilizotolewa kwa lugha zao za kawaida na lugha za kawaida.

source: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.
reference: Kwa kawaida, kununua chakula katika supamaketi ndiyo njia ya bei rahisi kabisa ya kujilisha. Bila fursa za kupika, machaguo hata hivyo yamepunguzwa kwa chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari.
hypothesis: Kuununua chakula katika maduka makubwa ni kawaida njia ya nafuu zaidi ya kupata chakula. Bila fursa za kupika, chaguzi zinazopatikana ni mdogo kwa chakula tayari.

source: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.
reference: Maduka makubwa yanazidi kupata seehemu ya chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari. Baadhi ya maduka makuu hutoa tanuri ya miale ya kupasha chakula joto.
hypothesis: Supermarkets zaidi na zaidi zina sehemu mbalimbali ya chakula tayari. Baadhi hata hutoa jiko la microwave au njia nyingine ya joto la chakula.

source: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.
reference: Katika baadhi ya nchi au aina za maduka kuna angalau mkahawa kwenye eneo, mara nyingi usio wa kirasmi na wenye bei nafuu.
hypothesis: Katika baadhi ya nchi au maduka ya aina fulani, kuna angalau moja ya chumba cha kula, mara nyingi ya aina isiyo rasmi na bei nafuu.

source: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
reference: Tengeneza na ubebe nakala za hati ya bima na maelezo ya mawasiliano ya mtoa huduma wako wa bima.
hypothesis: Jifanye na uwe na nakala za sera yako na maelezo ya mawasiliano ya bima yako.

source: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
reference: Wanahitaji kuonyesha anwani ya barua pepe na nambari za simu za kimataifa za mtoa bima kwa ushauri/idhini na kufanya madai.
hypothesis: Wao wanahitaji kuonyesha anwani ya barua pepe ya bima na namba za simu za kimataifa kwa ushauri/uthibitisho na kufanya madai.

source: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
reference: Kuwa na nakala nyingine katika mzigo wako na mtandaoni (baruapepe iliyo na kiambatisho kwako mwenyewe, au kuhifahiwa kwenye “wingu”).
hypothesis: Utafute nakala nyingine katika mizigo yako na mtandaoni (e-mail kwa mwenyewe na attachment, au kuhifadhiwa katika "mawingu").

source: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
reference: Kama unafasiri na kipakatilishi au kibao, hifadhi nakala kwenye kadi kasima yake(unayoweza kufikia bila mtandao)
hypothesis: Kama unapokuwa unatembea na kompyuta au kibao, hifadhi nakala yake kwenye kumbukumbu yake au disk (inayoweza kupatikana bila mtandao).

source: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
reference: Pia toa nakala za sera/mkataba kwa wenzi wa kusafiri na jamaa au marafiki nyumbani walio tayari kusaidia.
hypothesis: Unaweza pia kutoa nakala za sera/maelezo kwa marafiki wa kusafiri na ndugu au marafiki nyumbani ambao wanataka kusaidia.

source: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.
reference: Kongoni (pia wanajulikana kama elk) hawana fujo kiasili, lakini watajitetea ikiwa watakisia kuna hatari.
hypothesis: Simba (pia inajulikana kama tembo) si asili ya kivuli, lakini watautetea wenyewe kama wanapochunguza hatari.

source: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.
reference: Wakati watu hawaoni kongoni kama anayeweza kuwa hatari, huenda wakamsogea karibu sana na kujiweka hatarini.
hypothesis: Wakati watu hawatambui nyani kama hatari, wanaweza kufika karibu sana na hivyo kuweka mwenyewe katika hatari.

source: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
reference: Kunywa vinywaji vyenye pombe kwa kiasi tu. Pombe inaathiri kila mtu kwa njia tofauti, na kujua kiwango chako ni muhimu sana.
hypothesis: Kunywa pombe kwa kiasi. Pombe inaathiri watu tofauti, na kujua kiwango chako ni muhimu sana.

source: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.
reference: Matukio ya kiafya ya muda mrefu kutokana na kunywa kupita kiasi yanaweza kujumuisha uharibifu wa ini na hata upofu na kifo. Kuwepo kwa hatari huongezeka wakati wa kunywa pombe iliyotengenezwa kiharamu.
hypothesis: Matukio ya muda mrefu ya afya kutokana na kunywa kwa wingi yanaweza kuhusisha uharibifu wa ini na hata upofu na kifo. Hatari ya uwezekano ni kuongezeka wakati wa kunywa pombe zilizotengenezwa kinyume cha sheria.

source: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
reference: Mivinyo isiyo halali inaweza kuwa na uchafu mwingi hatari pamoja na methanoli, ambayo inaweza kusababisha upofu au kifo hata kwa kiasi kidogo.
hypothesis: Roho zisizo halali zinaweza kuwa na uchafu mbalimbali wenye hatari ikiwa ni pamoja na methanol, ambayo inaweza kusababisha upofu au kifo hata kwa kiasi kidogo.

source: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.
reference: Miwani inaweza kuwa bei rahisi katika nchi ya kigeni, haswa katika nchi za mapato ya chini ambapo gharama za kazi ziko chini.
hypothesis: Kwa nchi za kigeni, hasa katika nchi za chini za mapato ambako gharama za kazi ni chini, vifaa vya macho vinaweza kuwa nafuu.

source: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
reference: Fikiria kufanyiwa uchunguzi wa macho nyumbani, haswa ikiwa bima inaugharamia, na kuleta agizo nawe ili lifailiwe mahali pengine.
hypothesis: Kuzingatia kupata uchunguzi wa macho nyumbani, hasa ikiwa bima inakubali, na kuleta dawa ya macho ili kuiweka mahali pengine.

source: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.
reference: Fremu za kifahari za kampuni tajika ambazo hupatikana katika maeneo kama haya zina shida mbili; baadhi huenda zikawa ni nakala zisizo na leseni, na zile halisi zilizoletwa ndani huenda zikawa ghali zaidi kuliko nyumbani.
hypothesis: Kwa maeneo yenye bidhaa za juu za bidhaa zinazopatikana, zinaweza kuwa na matatizo mawili; baadhi yao zinaweza kuwa na knock-offs, na wale halisi wa nje wanaweza kuwa ghali zaidi kuliko nyumbani.

source: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.
reference: Kahawa ni mojawapo ya bidhaa zinazouzwa sana duniani, na labda unaweza kupata aina nyingi katika eneo lako la nyumbani.
hypothesis: Kahawa ni mojawapo ya bidhaa zinazouzwa zaidi duniani, na unaweza pengine kupata aina nyingi katika eneo lako la nyumbani.

source: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.
reference: Walakini, kuna njia nyingi za kipekee za kunywa kahawa ulimwenguni kote ambazo zinafaa kushuhudiwa.
hypothesis: Walau, kuna njia nyingi za kipekee za kunywa kahawa duniani ambazo ni thamani ya kujaribu.

source: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.
reference: Kuingia kwenye korongo (au: canyoneering) ni kuhusu kwenda chini ya korongo, ambayo imekauka au imejawa na maji.
hypothesis: Kanyoning (au: kanyoneering) ni kuhusu kwenda chini ya kanyoni, ambayo ni ama kavu au kamili ya maji.

source: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
reference: Mchezo wa korongo huchanganya vipengele kutoka kuogelea, kupanda na kuruka--lakini unahitaji mafunzo kiasi au hali nzuri ya kimwili ili kuanza (ukilinganishwa na kupanda mwamba, upigaji mbizi wa scuba au kuteleza milimani, kwa mfano).
hypothesis: Kanyoning inachanganya vipengele kutoka kwa kuogelea, kupanda na kuruka--lakini inahitaji mafunzo ya kutosha au hali ya kimwili ili kuanza (ikiwa ni pamoja na kupanda mawe, scuba diving au alpine skiing, kwa mfano).

source: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
reference: Matembezi ni shughuli ya nje ambayo huwa na kutembea katika mazingira asili, mara nyingi katika njia za matembezi.
hypothesis: Kukimbiza ni shughuli ya nje ambayo inahusisha kutembea katika mazingira ya asili, mara nyingi kwenye njia za kukimbiza.

source: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
reference: Matembezi ya mchana huhusisha umbali wa chini ya maili hadi umbali zaidi ambao unaweza kufikiwa kwa siku moja.
hypothesis: Day hiking inahusu umbali wa chini ya maili hadi umbali wa muda mrefu ambao unaweza kufikiwa ndani ya siku moja.

source: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
reference: Kwa matembezi ya mchana kando ya njia rahisi maandalizi kidogo yanahitajika, na mtu yeyote aliye na usawa wastani wa kimwili anaweza kufurahia.
hypothesis: Kwa siku ya kutembea kwa njia rahisi kidogo ya maandalizi yanahitajika, na mtu yeyote wenye fitness ya kawaida anaweza kufurahia.

source: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
reference: Huenda familia zilizo na watoto wadogo zikahitaji matayarisho mengi, lakini siku moja nje inawezekana kwa urahisi hata kukiwa na watoto wachanga na wale walio karibu kwenda shuleni.
hypothesis: Familia zinazoongozwa na watoto wadogo wanaweza kuhitaji maandalizi zaidi, lakini siku ya nje ni rahisi kufanyika hata na watoto wadogo na watoto wa shule ya awali.

source: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
reference: Kimataifa, kuna mashirika karibu 200 ya ziara za mbio. Nyingi kati yazo hufanya kazi kwa uhuru.
hypothesis: Kimataifa, kuna karibu 200 mashirika ya safari za kukimbia. Wengi wao wanafanya kazi kwa kujitegemea.

source: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.
reference: Mrithi wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours huunganisha makundi mengi ya kutoa huduma ya ukimbiaji na utazamaji kwenye mabara manne.
hypothesis: Kiongozi wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours, inaunganisha mamia ya watoa huduma za sightrunning katika bara la Afrika, Amerika, Ulaya, na Asia.

source: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.
reference: Kwa mizizi ya Running Tours huko Barcelona na Copenhagen’s Running kwa Copenhagen, ilijumuishwa haraka na Running Tours huko Prague na wengineo.
hypothesis: Kwa mizizi katika Running Tours Barcelona ya Barcelona na Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, ilikuwa haraka ikaunganishwa na Running Tours Prague iliyoko Prague na wengine.

source: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
reference: Kuna mambo mengi sana unayofaa kutilia maanani kabla na wakati wa kusafiri mahali.
hypothesis: Kuna mambo mengi unayohitaji kuzingatia kabla na wakati wa kusafiri kwenda mahali fulani.

source: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
reference: Unaposafiri, tarajia mambo yasiwe kama yalivyo “nyumbani”. Tabia, sheria, chakula, trafiki, mahali pa kulala, viwango, lugha na kadhalika zitatofautiana kwa kiwango fulani na mahali unapoishi.
hypothesis: Unapokwenda, unapaswa kutarajia mambo siyo kama nyumbani. Tabia, sheria, chakula, trafiki, malazi, viwango, lugha na kadhalika yatadumu tofauti na ambapo unatoka.

source: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
reference: Hili ni jambo ambalo unahitaji kukumbuka kila wakati, ili kuepuka kukata tamaa au hata kuchukizwa na njia za kawaida za kufanya mambo.
hypothesis: Huwa unapaswa kukumbuka jambo hili mara kwa mara, ili kuepuka kukatishwa tamaa au hata kuchukizwa na njia za ndani za kufanya mambo.

source: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.
reference: Mawakala wa usafiri wamekuwapo tangu karne ya 19. Kwa kawaida wakala wa usafiri huwa chaguo zuri kwa safari ambayo ni zaidi ya uzoefu wa awali wa msafiri wa maumbile, utamaduni, lugha au nchi za mapato madogo.
hypothesis: Biashara za usafiri zimekuwa zipo tangu karne ya 19. Wakala wa usafiri ni chaguo nzuri kwa safari ambayo inazidi uzoefu wa msafiri wa asili, utamaduni, lugha, au nchi za chini za mapato.

source: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.
reference: Ingawa mashirika mengi ya uwakala yako tayari kufanya uhifadhi mwingi wa kawaida, mawakala wengi hushughulika na aina maalum za usafiri, masafa ya bajeti au mahali pa kwenda.
hypothesis: Wakati wengi wa wakala ni tayari kuchukua bookings kawaida, wakala wengi maalumu katika aina maalumu ya usafiri, bajeti mbalimbali au maeneo.

source: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.
reference: Inaweza kuwa afadhali kutumia wakala ambaye huhifadhi safari sawa na yako kila wakati.
hypothesis: Inaweza kuwa bora kutumia mwendeshaji ambaye mara nyingi ana kitabu kama safari yako.

source: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
reference: Angalia ni safari zipi ambazo wakala anapendekeza, iwe kwenye tovuti au kwenye dirisha la duka.
hypothesis: Angalia nini kampuni ya usafiri inazitangaza, kama kwenye wavuti au kwenye madirisha ya duka.

source: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.
reference: Ikiwa unataka kuuona ulimwengu kwa urahisi, kwa umuhimu, mtindo wa maisha au chamgamoto, kuna baadhi ya njia za kufanya hivyo.
hypothesis: Kama unataka kuona ulimwengu kwa bei nafuu, kwa sababu ya mahitaji, maisha au changamoto, kuna njia za kufanya hivyo.

source: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.
reference: Kimsingi wao huwa katika vikundi viwili: fanya kazi ukiwa safarini ama jaribu upunguze gharama zako. Nakala hii inaangazia wa mwisho.
hypothesis: Kwa kifupi, wao huanguka katika makundi mawili: Au kufanya kazi wakati wa kusafiri au jaribu kupunguza matumizi. Makala hii ni iliyoundwa kwa ajili ya la mwisho.

source: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.
reference: Kwa wale walio tayari kuacha starehe, muda na utabiri ili kupunguza garama hadi sufuri, angalia usafiri wa bajeti ndogo.
hypothesis: Kwa wale wanaotaka kutoa usumbufu, muda na utabiri ili kupunguza gharama karibu na sifuri, tazama usafiri wa bajeti ya chini.

source: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.
reference: Ushauri huo unachukulia kuwa wasafiri hawaibi, hawana uingiliaji, hawashiriki katika soko haramu, hawaombi, au kunyonya watu wengine kwa faida yao.
hypothesis: Usaidizi huo unaeleza kwamba wasafiri hawana kuchukua vitu bila ruhusa, kuingia kwa kinyume cha sheria, kushiriki katika soko la kinyume cha sheria, kuomba, au kutumia watu wengine kwa faida yao wenyewe.

source: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.
reference: Kituo cha kukaguliwa kwa wahamiaji kwa kawaida ndipo mahali pa kwanza kusimama unaposhuka kwenye ndege, meli ama gari jingine.
hypothesis: Kituo cha uhamiaji ni mara nyingi hatua ya kwanza wakati wa kushuka kutoka ndege, meli, au gari lingine.

source: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.
reference: Katika baadhi ya garimoshi zinazovuka mipaka ukaguzi hufanywa terni likiwa kwenye mwendo na hivyo unapaswa kuwa na kitambulisho halali unapopanda mojawapo ya treni hizo.
hypothesis: Katika baadhi ya treni za mpakani, uchunguzi hufanywa kwenye treni inayoendesha na unapaswa kuwa na ID halali wakati wa kuingia kwenye moja ya treni hizo.

source: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.
reference: Kwenye treni za kulala usiku, pasipoti zinaweza kukusanywa na kondakta ili usingizi wako usitatizwe.
hypothesis: Katika mabasi ya kulala usiku, pasipoti zako zinaweza kukusanywa na dereva ili usiwe na usingizi wako unatumiwa.

source: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.
reference: Usajili ni hitaji la ziada kwa mchakato wa visa. Katika baadhi ya nchi, ni lazima usajili uwepo wako na anwani ya unakokaa na mamlaka ya ndani.
hypothesis: Usajili ni mahitaji ya ziada kwa mchakato wa visa. Katika baadhi ya nchi, unahitaji kuhesabu uwepo wako na anwani ambapo unakaa na mamlaka za ndani.

source: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.
reference: Hii huenda ikahitaji kujaza fomu na polisi wa ndani au ziara katika ofisi za uhamiaji.
hypothesis: Inaweza kuhitaji kujaza fomu na polisi wa eneo hilo au kutembelea ofisi za uhamiaji.

source: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).
reference: Katika nchi nyingi zilizo na sheria kama hiyo, hoteli za ndani zitashughulikia usajili (hakikisha umeuliza).
hypothesis: Katika nchi nyingi zenye sheria hiyo, hoteli za ndani zitahusika na usajili (kumbuka kuuliza).

source: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.
reference: Katika kesi nyingine, wale tu wanoishi nje ya makazi ya watlii wanafaa kujiandikisha. Lakini, hii inafanya sheria kuwa fiche, kwa hivyo jua mapema.
hypothesis: Katika kesi nyingine, tu wale wanaoishi nje ya malazi ya utalii wanahitajika kujaza fomu ya usajili. Hata hivyo, hii inafanya sheria kuwa ya kushangaza zaidi, hivyo jifunze mapema.

source: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.
reference: Majenzi yanahusika na ubunifu na ujenzi wa majengo. Mara nyingi majenzi ya mahali ni kivutio cha watalii kivyake.
hypothesis: Ujenzi ni kuhusu kubuni na ujenzi wa majengo. Ujenzi wa mahali fulani mara nyingi ni utalii wa kipekee.

source: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.
reference: Majengo mengi ni mazuri sana kutazama na mtazamo kutoka kwa jengo refu au kutoka kwa dirisha lililowekwa kwa ujanja unaweza kuwa uzuri wa ajabu.
hypothesis: Wengi wa majengo ni nzuri sana kuangalia na mtazamo kutoka kwa jengo la juu au kutoka kwa dirisha lililowekwa kwa busara ni uzuri wa kuona.

source: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.
reference: Majenzi huingiliana sana na nyanja nyingine zikiwemo mipango ya mji, uhandisi wa umma, sanaa za mapambo, ubunifu wa ndani na ubunifu wa mandhari.
hypothesis: Ujenzi unaunganishwa sana na mafundisho mengine ikiwa ni pamoja na mipango ya mji, uhandisi wa umma, sanaa za mapambo, kubuni ndani na kubuni mandhari.

source: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.
reference: Kwa kuzingatia umbali wa wapueblo wengi, hutaweza kupata maisha ya usiku ya maana bila kusafiri kwenda Albakuku au Santa Fe.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa pueblos nyingi ni mbali sana, hutaweza kupata kiasi kikubwa cha nightlife bila kusafiri kwenda Albuquerque au Santa Fe.

source: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).
reference: Walakini, karibu kasino zote zilizoorodheshwa hapo juu hutoa vinywaji, na kadhaa huleta chapa tajika za burudani (kimsingi zile kubwa zinazozingira Albukuku na Santa Fe moja kwa moja).
hypothesis: Walakini, karibu casino zote zilizotajwa hapo juu zinatoa vinywaji, na baadhi yao huchukua burudani ya jina (hasa kubwa zilizopo karibu na Albuquerque na Santa Fe).

source: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.
reference: Jihadhari: Baa za mji mdogo hapa sio mahali pazuri kwa mgeni wa nje ya nchi kutangamana.
hypothesis: Kwa tahadhari: baa za mji ndogo hapa si mara zote mahali pazuri kwa mgeni wa nje ya hali.

source: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.
reference: Kwa jambo moja, kaskazini mwa New Meksiko mna shida kubwa ya uendeshaji gari kwa ulevi, na idadi kubwa ya madereva walevi iko karibu sana na baa za miji midogo.
hypothesis: Kwa kitu kimoja, New Mexico ya Kaskazini ina matatizo makubwa na madereva waliochukia, na kuzungukwa na madereva waliochukia karibu na baa za kijiji.

source: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.
reference: Michoro ya kuta au maandishi yasiyotakikana yanajulikana kama grafiti.
hypothesis: Graffiti ni picha zisizotakiwa au maandishi yaliyochorwa kwenye sehemu za umma.

source: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.
reference: Huku ikiwa mbali na tukio la kisasa, watu wengi labda huishirikisha na vijana kuharibu mali ya kibinafsi na ya umma kutumia rangi ya kunyunyizia.
hypothesis: Wakati huo hauwezi kusemwa kuwa ni jambo la kisasa, watu wengi wanaweza kuhusishwa na vijana kuharibu mali ya umma na binafsi kwa kutumia rangi ya kuchapisha.

source: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.
reference: Walakini, siku hizi kuna wasanii wa grafiti waliobobea, hafla za michoro na kuta “halali”. Uchoraji wa grafiti kwenye muktadha huu mara nyingi hufanana na kazi za kisanaa badala ya vitambulisho visivyosomeka. "
hypothesis: Walakini, kuna wasanii wa graffiti walioanzishwa, matukio ya graffiti, na "mawingi" halali. Mchoro wa graffiti katika mazingira haya mara nyingi hujikunyata kama sanaa badala ya tags isiyojulikana.

source: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.
reference: Utupaji wa bumarengi ni ujuzi maarufu ambao watalii wengi wanataka kupata.
hypothesis: Utapakiaji wa boomerang ni ujuzi maarufu ambao watalii wengi wanataka kujifunza.

source: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.
reference: Ukitaka kujua kutupa bumarengi inayorudi kwa mkono yako, hakikisha uko na bumerang’i sahihi itakayorudi.
hypothesis: Kama unataka kujifunza kutupa boomerang ambayo inarudi kwa mkono wako, hakikisha una boomerang sahihi kwa kurudi.

source: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy
reference: Bumerangi nyingi zinazopatikana Australia si za kurudi tena. Ni vizuri kwa wanaoanza wasijaribu kuzirusha wakati wa upepo
hypothesis: Wengi wa boomerangs zinazopatikana nchini Australia ni kweli si kurudi. Ni bora kwa wapya kwa si kujaribu kutupa katika upepo.

source: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.
reference: Mlo wa Hangi hupikiwa kwenye shimo lenye joto ardhini.
hypothesis: Chakula cha Hangi kinachwa katika shimo la moto kwenye ardhi.

source: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.
reference: Shimo hilo huchomwa kwa mawe moto kutoka kwa moto, au katika baadhi ya maeneo nishati ya jua huyafanya maeneo ya ardhi kiasilia kuwa moto.
hypothesis: Kaburi hilo linaweza kuchomwa na mawe ya moto kutoka kwa moto, au katika baadhi ya maeneo, joto la joto la ardhi linafanya maeneo ya ardhi ya asili ya moto.

source: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.
reference: Hangi hutumika mara nyingi kupikia chajio cha mtindo wa kuchoma.
hypothesis: Hangi hutumiwa mara nyingi kwa kupika chakula cha jioni la kisasa la kisasa.

source: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.
reference: Sehemu kadhaa katika Rotorua hutoa hangi ya jotoardhi, wakati hangi nyingine zinaweza kupatikana katika Christchurch, Wellington na kwingineko.
hypothesis: Baadhi ya maeneo ya Rotorua hutoa hangi ya geothermal, wakati hangi nyingine zinaweza kupatikana katika Christchurch, Wellington na mahali pengine.

source: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).
reference: MetroRail ina daraja mbili katika treni za abiria ndani na karibu na Cape Town: MetroPlus (pia huitwa Daraja la Kwanza) na Metro (huitwa Daraja la Tatu).
hypothesis: Metrorail ina darasa mbili kwenye mabasi ya abiria karibu na Cape Town: MetroPlus (pia inaitwa Darasa la Kwanza) na Metro (inaitwa Darasa la Tatu).

source: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.
reference: MetroPlus ina starehe zaidi na haina msongamano lakini ni ya bei ghali kiasi, ingawa bado ni ya bei ya chini kuliko tiketi za kawaida za reli huko Uropa.
hypothesis: MetropolitanPlus ni zaidi ya starehe na chini ya watu lakini gharama kidogo zaidi, ingawa bado ni nafuu kuliko tiketi za metro za kawaida barani Ulaya.

source: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.
reference: Kila treni ina kochi za MetroPlus na Metro; kila wakati kochi za MetroPlus huwa katika upande wa treni ulioko karibu na Cape Town.
hypothesis: Kila treni ina mabasi ya MetroPlus na Metro; mabasi ya MetroPlus daima yamo kwenye mwisho wa treni karibu na Cape Town.

source: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.
reference: Kuwabebea wengine - Usiwahi kuondoa macho yako kwenye begi zako, hasa unapovuka mipaka ya kimataifa.
hypothesis: Kuwa na watu wengine - Usiruhusu mizigo yako nje ya macho yako, hasa wakati wa kuvuka mipaka ya kimataifa.

source: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.
reference: Unaweza kujipata ukitumiwa kama msafirishaji wa dawa za kulevya bila kujua, jambo ambalo litakuweka katika shida kubwa.
hypothesis: Unaweza kupatikana mwenyewe kutumika kama carrier wa madawa bila ujuzi wako, ambayo itakupa katika shida kubwa.

source: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.
reference: Hii ni pamoja na kungoja kwenye foleni, wakati mbwa wa kunusa dawa wanaweza kutumiwa wakati wowote bila notisi.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, unapaswa kusubiri kwa muda mrefu, kama mbwa wa kuchunguza madawa ya kulevya wanaweza kutumika wakati wowote bila taarifa.

source: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.
reference: Baadhi ya nchi zina adhabu za kibabe zaidi hata kwa makosa ya kwanza; hizi zinaweza kuhusisha kufungwa jela kwa zaidi ya miaka 10 ama kifo.
hypothesis: Baadhi ya nchi zina adhabu kali sana hata kwa makosa ya kwanza; hizi zinaweza kuhusisha kifungo cha jela cha zaidi ya miaka 10 au kifo.

source: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.
reference: Begi zisizotunzwa ni lengo la wizi na pia zinaweza kuvutia umakinifu kutoka kwa mamlaka wanaohofia vitishio vya bomu.
hypothesis: Bagi zisizochukuliwa na mtu ni laana ya wizi na pia zinaweza kuvutia tahadhari kutoka kwa mamlaka zenye wasiwasi kuhusu vitisho vya bomu.

source: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.
reference: Nyumbani, kwa sababu ya kuwa kwenye viini vya ndani kila wakati, kuna uwezekano mkubwa kwamba tayari una kinga dhidi yavyo.
hypothesis: Nyumbani, kutokana na muda mrefu wa kuwa na mawasiliano na vimelea vya ndani, uwezekano wa kuwa tayari umekomaa dhidi yao ni mkubwa.

source: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.
reference: Lakini katika sehemu nyingine za dunia, ambapo wanyama wa kibakteria ni wapya kwako, una uwezekano mkubwa zaidi wa kukumbwa na shida.
hypothesis: Lakini katika sehemu nyingine za dunia, ambapo mifugo ya bakteria ni mpya kwako, unazidi kuwa na shida.

source: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.
reference: Pia, katika hali joto za hewa bakteria hukua kwa haraka na kuishi kwa muda mrefu nje ya mwili.
hypothesis: Kwa upande mwingine, katika mazingira ya joto bakteria hupanda haraka zaidi na hupatikana nje ya mwili kwa muda mrefu zaidi.

source: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.
reference: Hivyo pigo la Delhi Belly, Laana ya Firauni, Kisasi cha Montezuma, na marafiki zao wengi.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, Delhi Belly, Laana ya Farao, Montezuma's Revenge, na marafiki wao wengi.

source: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.
reference: Kama vile shida za kupumua katika hali baridi za hewa, shida za mara katika hali joto za hewa ni kawaida kiasi, na katika hali nyingi hukera wazi lakini si hatari kwa kweli.
hypothesis: Kama na matatizo ya kupumua katika mazingira baridi, matatizo ya tumbo katika mazingira ya joto ni ya kawaida na kwa kawaida ni ya kushangaza lakini si hatari sana.

source: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.
reference: Ikiwa unasafiri kwa mara ya kwanza katika taifa linaoendelea – au katika sehemu geni ulimwenguni – usipuuze uwezekano wa mshtuko wa kitamaduni.
hypothesis: Kama wewe ni kusafiri katika nchi zinazoendelea kwa mara ya kwanza - au katika sehemu mpya ya dunia - usiudhuru uharibifu wa utamaduni.

source: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.
reference: Wasafiri wengi wenye uwezo wameshindwa na upya wa usafiri wa ulimwengu unaokua, ambapo marekebisho mengi madogo ya kitamaduni yanaweza kuongezeka haraka.
hypothesis: Watu wengi wenye uzoefu wa kusafiri na uwezo wamekabiliwa na utofauti wa kusafiri duniani kote, ambapo mabadiliko madogo ya utamaduni yanaweza kuchukua muda wa haraka.

source: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.
reference: Hasa katika siku zako za mwanzo, zingatia utumizi wa pesa kwa wingi katika hoteli za mitindo ya Magharibi na bora, chakula, na huduma za kusaidia kujizoesha.
hypothesis: Hasa katika siku zako za mwanzo, fikiria kuharibu juu ya hoteli za kisasa za Magharibi, chakula, na huduma ili kusaidia kubadilika.

source: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.
reference: Usilalie godoro au mto kwenye ardhi katika maeneo ambayo hujui wanyama wake wa kienyeji.
hypothesis: Usiulize kitanda au kitanda chako kwenye ardhi ambako hujui wanyama wa eneo hilo.

source: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.
reference: Ikiwa unapanga kukaa kambini, beba kitanda kidogo cha kambini au kitanda cha bembea ili ujiepushe na nyoka, nge na vitu kama hivyo.
hypothesis: Kama unaenda kambi, kuleta kitanda cha kambi au hammock ili kukupunguzia nyoka, skorpioni na mambo mengine.

source: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.
reference: Jaza nyumba yako na kahawa bora asubuhi na chai ya kutuliza ya chamomile jioni.
hypothesis: Kujaza nyumba yako na kahawa yenye ladha ya kutosha asubuhi na chai ya utulivu ya chamomile usiku.

source: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.
reference: Wakati uko katika likizo karibu na nyumbani, una muda wa kujifurahisha na kuchukua dakika chache za ziada kutengeneza kitu spesheli.
hypothesis: Wakati wewe ni juu ya likizo ya nyumbani, una muda wa kutunza mwenyewe na kuchukua dakika chache za ziada kwa kuchoma kitu maalum.

source: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:
reference: Ikiwa unajisikia jasiri zaidi, chukua fursa ya kutengeneza juisi au sharubati fulani:
hypothesis: Kama unajisikia kuwa na ujasiri zaidi, fanya nafasi ya juicing au kuchanganya smoothies:

source: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.
reference: pengine utagundua kinywaji rahisi ambacho unaweza kutengeneza kwa kiamshakinywa utakaporejea utaratibu wako wa kila siku.
hypothesis: Labda utagundua kunywa rahisi unaweza kufanya kwa kifungua kinywa wakati unarejea kwenye utaratibu wako wa kila siku.

source: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.
reference: Kama unaishi kwenye mji ulio na utamdauni wa kunywa, nenda kwenye baa jirani ambazo huendi mara kwa mara.
hypothesis: Kama unaishi katika mji unaoongoza utamaduni wa kunywa, tembelea baa au baa katika maeneo ambayo hujawahi kutembelea.

source: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.
reference: Kwa wale wasioelewa lugha ya kimatibabu, jina maambukuzi na kuambukizwa yana maana tofauti.
hypothesis: Kwa wale ambao hawajui lugha ya matibabu, maneno ya kuambukiza na kueneza yana maana tofauti.

source: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.
reference: Ugonjwa wenye maambukizi ni ule unaosababishwa na pathojeni, kama vile kirusi, bakteria, kuvu au vimelea wengine.
hypothesis: Ugonjwa usioambukizwa ni ugonjwa unaosababishwa na pathogen, kama virusi, bakteria, fungi au wadudu wengine.

source: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
reference: Ugonjwa ambukizi ni ugonjwa ambao unasambazwa kwa urahisi kwa kuwa karibu na mtu aliyeambukizwa.
hypothesis: Ugonjwa wa kuambukiza ni ugonjwa ambao unaweza kwa urahisi kusambazwa kwa kuwa karibu na mtu aliyeambukizwa.

source: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.
reference: Serikali nyingi zinahitaji wageni wanaoingia, au wenyeji wanaoondoka kwenye nchi zao kuchanjwa dhidi ya magonjwa tofauti.
hypothesis: Watu wengi wanaotembelea au wanaoondoka nchi wanahitajika kuwa walivikishwa kwa aina mbalimbali za magonjwa na serikali zao.

source: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
reference: Mara nyingi mahitaji haya huenda yakategemea ni nchi gani msafiri amezuru au anakusudia kuzuru.
hypothesis: Mahitaji haya yanaweza mara nyingi kutegemea nchi ambazo msafiri amezitembelea au anatarajia kutembelea.

source: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.
reference: Mojawapo ya sifa kali za Charlotte, Carolina Kaskazini, ni kwamba ina idadi kubwa ya machaguo ya hali ya juu kwa familia.
hypothesis: Moja ya mambo bora ya Charlotte, North Carolina, ni kwamba ina mengi ya chaguzi za ubora kwa familia.

source: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.
reference: Wakazi kutoka maeneo mengine mara nyingi hutaja urafiki wa kifamilia kama sababu msingi ya kuhamia huko, na mara nyingi wageni huchukulia mji kuwa rahisi kufurahia na watoto wakiwa karibu.
hypothesis: Wakazi kutoka maeneo mengine mara nyingi kutoa urafiki wa familia kama sababu ya msingi ya kuhamia huko, na wageni mara nyingi kupata mji rahisi kufurahia na watoto karibu.

source: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.
reference: Katika miaka 20 iliyopita, kiasi machaguo yenye kuwapendeza watoto huko Uptown Charlotte yamekuwa yakiongezeka.
hypothesis: Katika miaka 20 iliyopita, idadi ya chaguzi za watoto zilizopo katika Uptown Charlotte imeongezeka kwa kiasi kikubwa.

source: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.
reference: Kwa jumla teksi hutumiwa na familia katika Charlotte, ingawa zinaweza kutumika kiasi katika hali fulani.
hypothesis: Matatizo hayakubaliki sana kwa familia huko Charlotte, ingawa wanaweza kutumika katika hali fulani.

source: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.
reference: Kuna kuongeza fedha za ziada kwa kuwa na abiria zaidi ya 2, kwa hivyo chaguo hili linaweza kuwa ghali kuliko inavyohitajika.
hypothesis: Kuna ada ya ziada kwa kuwa na abiria zaidi ya 2, hivyo chaguo hili linaweza kuwa ghali zaidi kuliko inahitajika.

source: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.
reference: Antaktika ndio mahali baridi zaidi Duniani na huzunguka Nguzo la Kusini.
hypothesis: Antarctica ni sehemu yenye baridi zaidi duniani, na inazunguka Pole ya Kusini.

source: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.
reference: Ziara za watalii ni za gharama kubwa, zinahitaji usawa wa kimwili, zinaweza kufanyika tu katika msimu wa joto wa Novemba-Februari, na kwa njia kubwa zinafanyika tu Peninsula, Visiwani na Bahari ya Ross.
hypothesis: Watalii wanaotembelea ni gharama kubwa, wanahitaji fitness ya kimwili, zinaweza kufanyika tu katika majira ya joto Nov-Feb, na zinazidiwa sana na Peninsula, Islands na Ross Sea.

source: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.
reference: Maelfu machache ya wafanyakazi huishi hapa wakati wa kiangazi kwenye dazeni nne za makazi aghalabu katika maeneo hayo; idadi ndogo hukaa wakati wa msimu wa baridi.
hypothesis: Wafanyakazi wachache wanaishi hapa katika majira ya joto katika baadhi ya makao makuu 40, hasa katika maeneo hayo; idadi ndogo ya watu hushikilia juu ya baridi.

source: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.
reference: Bara la Antaktiki ni jangwa la ukiwa lililofunikwa na kilomita 2-3 za barafu.
hypothesis: Antarctica ya ndani ni bonde la baridi lenye urefu wa 2-3 km wa barafu.

source: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
reference: Safari za anga za mara kwa mara za wataalam huenda bara, kwa upandaji milima au kufikia Nchani, ambayo ina msingi mkubwa.
hypothesis: Matukio ya muda mrefu ya ndege za mtaalamu hupitia ndani, kwa maporomoko ya mlima au kufikia Pole, ambayo ina msingi mkubwa.

source: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.
reference: Njia ya Ncha ya Kusini (au Barabara Kuu) ni njia yenye urefu wa kilomita 1600 kutoka Kituo cha McMurdo katika Bahari ya Ross hadi kwenye ncha.
hypothesis: South Pole Traverse (au Barabara ya South Pole) ni barabara ya kilomita 1600 kutoka Kituo cha McMurdo kwenye Bahari ya Ross hadi Pole.

source: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.
reference: Ni theluji iliyoshikanishwa na mianya kuzibwa ndani na kuwekwa alama ya bendera. Inaweza kusafiriwa tu na matrekta maalum, magari ya kukokota kwenye theluji yenye mafuta na vifaa.
hypothesis: Kuna theluji iliyopigwa na kina na kina zilizofungwa na bendera. Inaweza kutembelewa tu na traktors maalumu, zilizopigwa na sleds na mafuta na vifaa.

source: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
reference: Hizi si nyepesi sana kwa hivyo inabidi treni kuchukua mzunguko mrefu katika Milima ya Transantarctic ili kuja kwenye tambarare.
hypothesis: These si nimble sana hivyo njia inapaswa kuchukua muda mrefu swerve karibu Transantarctic Mountains kuja juu ya plateau.

source: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.
reference: Sababu ya kawaida zaidi ya ajali katika msimu wa baridi ni barabara, lami (vijia vya kando) na hasa ngazi zenye utelezi.
hypothesis: Chanzo kikuu cha ajali za barabarani wakati wa majira ya baridi ni barabara zilizochafuka, maeneo ya kutembea na hasa hatua.

source: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.
reference: Kwa kiwango cha chini, unahitaji viatu vilivyo na nyayo zinazofaa. Viatu vya kiangazi kwa kawaida huwa telezi sana katika barafu na theluji, hata buti za baridi zina upungufu.
hypothesis: Kwa kiwango cha chini, unahitaji viatu na miguu yenye sahihi. Viatu vya majira ya joto ni kawaida sana slippery juu ya barafu na theluji, hata baadhi ya viatu vya majira ya baridi ni madhubuti.

source: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.
reference: Ruwaza hiyo inapaswa kuwa na kina kirefu, milimita 5 (inchi 1/5) au zaidi, na nyenzo laini za kutosha katika hali ya baridi.
hypothesis: Utaratibu huo unapaswa kuwa mkubwa kutosha, 5 mm (1/5 inch) au zaidi, na nyenzo hiyo iwe laini kutosha katika hali ya baridi.

source: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.
reference: Baadhi ya buti zina hazama na kuna zana za nyongeza zilizo na hazama kwa hali telezi, zinazofaa kwa viatu na buti nyingi, kwa kisigino au kisigino na wayo.
hypothesis: Baadhi ya buti zina studs na kuna vifaa vya studded add-on kwa hali ya slippery, yanafaa kwa buti nyingi na vifaa, kwa heels au heels na sole.

source: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
reference: Viatu vya juu vinafaa kua chini na pana.Mchanga, kokoto au chumvi (Kloridi kalsiamu) mara nyingi hupatikana zimetawanyika kwenye barabara na njia ili kuboresha msuguano.
hypothesis: Kwa miguu chini na pana. Sand, changarawe au chumvi (calcium chloride) mara nyingi yameenea barabarani au kwenye njia ili kuboresha traction.

source: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.
reference: Maporomoko ya theluji si uhitilafiani wa kawaida; mteremko mkali unaweza kushikilia theluji kiwango fulani, na viwango vya ziada vitashuka kama maporomoko ya theluji.
hypothesis: Uvamizi si jambo la kawaida; milima yenye urefu wa juu inaweza kuhifadhi tu kiasi kidogo cha polepole, na kiasi kilichobaki kitatoka chini kama uvamizi.

source: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.
reference: Tatizo ni kwamba theluji ni danganyifu, kwa hivyo inahitaji kuanzishwa ili iteremke, na kuteremka kwa theluji kidogo huenda kukawa tukio la kuanzisha iliyobaki.
hypothesis: Matatizo ni kwamba barafu ni sticky, hivyo inahitaji baadhi ya trigger kuja chini, na baadhi ya barafu kuja chini inaweza kuwa tukio trigger kwa wengine.

source: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
reference: Wakati mwingine tukio asilia linalochochea ni jua kupasha joto theluji, wakati mwingine kuanguka zaidi kwa theluji, wakati mwingine matukio ya asili, mara nyingi binadamu.
hypothesis: Wakati mwingine tukio la awali ni jua jikwaa barafu, wakati mwingine snowfall zaidi, wakati mwingine matukio mengine ya asili, mara nyingi binadamu.

source: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.
reference: Tufani ni safuwima inayozunguka iliyo na presha ya chini sana ya hewa, ambayo hufyonza hewa ya karibu ndani na juu.
hypothesis: Twister ni safu ya hewa yenye shinikizo la chini sana, ambayo hupuliza hewa ya karibu na juu.

source: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.
reference: Wanafanyiza upepo (mara nyingi maili 100-200 kwa saa) na kuinua vitu vizito hewani, kubeba kama vile chemchela.
hypothesis: Wao hutoa upepo mkubwa (mara nyingi 100-200 maili / saa) na wanaweza kuinua vitu vingi juu ya anga, kubeba yao kama tornado inayovuka.

source: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.
reference: Huanza kama faneli zinazoshuka kutoka kwenye mawingu ya dhoruba, na yakawa tufani yanapogusa ardhi."
hypothesis: Wao kuanza kama funnels kushuka kutoka mawingu mvua, na kuwa "tornadoes" wakati wao kugusa ardhi.

source: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.
reference: Watoaji wa VPN (mtandao pepe wa kibinafsi) ya kibinafsi ni njia bora ya kukwepa uzuiaji wa kisiasa na uchujaji wa kibiashara wa IP kulingana na eneo.
hypothesis: Wasanidi wa VPN binafsi ni njia bora ya kuzunguka ushuru wa kisiasa na IP-geofiltering ya kibiashara.

source: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.
reference: Ni bora kuliko wakala wa tovuti kwa sababu kadhaa: Huelekeza upya trafiki yote ya intaneti, si http pekee.
hypothesis: Wao ni bora kuliko proxies za wavuti kwa sababu kadhaa: Wao hupeleka trafiki zote za mtandao, si tu http.

source: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.
reference: Kwa kawaida huwa wanatoa upana wa bendi wa juu na huduma bora zaidi. Wamesimbwa kwa hivyo ni vigumu kuwapeleleza.
hypothesis: Wao kawaida kutoa bandwidth juu na ubora wa huduma bora. Wao ni encrypted na hivyo vigumu kwa kupeleleza.

source: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".
reference: Kampuni za midia daima hudanganya kuhusu madhumuni ya hili, zikidai kwamba ni kwa “kuzuia uharamu”.
hypothesis: Kampuni za vyombo vya habari mara kwa mara wanaficha kuhusu madhumuni ya hii, wakisema kwamba ni "kuzuia uvamizi".

source: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.
reference: Kwa kweli, misimbo ya mikoa hazina athari kabisa kwa unakilishaji haramu; nakala ndogo ndogo za diski zitacheza tu vizuri kwenye kifaa chochote kinachocheza nakala halisi.
hypothesis: Kwa kweli, codes za eneo hawana madhara yoyote juu ya nakala ya kinyume cha sheria; nakala ya biti-kwa-bit ya disk itacheza vizuri kwenye kifaa chochote ambapo awali itakuwa.

source: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.
reference: Lengo halisi ni kuzipatia kampuni hizo udhibiti zaidi wa masoko yake; yote ni kuhusu kutengeneza pesa.
hypothesis: Kikamilifu lengo ni kutoa makampuni hayo udhibiti zaidi wa masoko yao; ni kuhusu fedha spin.

source: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.
reference: Kwa sababu simu hupitishwa kwenye intaneti, huhitaji kutumia kampuni ya simu iliyo mahali unakoishi au unakosafiri.
hypothesis: Kwa sababu wito hutumiwa kupitia mtandao, huna haja ya kutumia kampuni ya simu iliyoko mahali ulipo au mahali unapokwenda.

source: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.
reference: Pia hakuna sharti kwamba upate nambari ya kienyeji kutoka kwa jamii unakoishi; unaweza kupata unganisho la mtandao wa satelaiti kwenye porini ya Chicken, Alaska na uchague nambari inayodai uko katika Arizona yenye jua.
hypothesis: Kuna pia hakuna mahitaji kwamba unapaswa kupata idadi ya ndani kutoka kwa jamii ambayo unaoishi; unaweza kupata uunganisho wa Internet ya satelaiti katika wilaya za Kuku, Alaska na kuchagua idadi ambayo inadai unapoishi Arizona.

source: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
reference: Mara nyingi, unafaa kununua kando nambari ya kimataifa ambayo inakubali simu za PSTN kukupigia. Mahali nambari hiyo imetoka huleta tofauti kwa watu wanaokupigia.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi, unahitaji kununua idadi ya kimataifa tofauti ambayo inaruhusu PSTN simu za simu kukutumia. Ambapo idadi hiyo ni kutoka ina umuhimu kwa watu wanaokuita.

source: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
reference: Programu za utafsiri wa matini kwa wakati halisi – programu-tumizi ambazo zina uwezo wa kutafsiri sehemu nzima za matini kutoka lugha moja kwa nyingine kiotomatiki.
hypothesis: Real-time maombi ya mhariri wa maandishi – maombi ambayo yanaweza kubadilisha sehemu nzima ya maandishi kutoka lugha moja hadi nyingine kwa urahisi.

source: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
reference: Baadhi ya programu-tumizi katika kategoria hii zinaweza hata kutafsiri matini ya lugha za kigeni kwenye vibao vya ishara au vitu vingine katika dunia halisi wakati mtumiaji anapoelekeza simu maizi kwenye vitu hivyo.
hypothesis: Baadhi ya maombi katika jamii hii hata kutafsiri maandishi ya lugha za kigeni kwenye ishara au vitu vingine katika ulimwengu wa kweli wakati mtumiaji anapoweka smartphone yake kuelekea kwenye vitu hivyo.

source: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
reference: Injini za utafsiri zimeimarika sana, na sasa mara nyingi hutoa tafsiri inayokaribia usahihi (na kawaida huwa si upuzi), lakini umakini unahitajika, kwani zinaweza kuwa zimekosea kabisa.
hypothesis: Matumizi ya injini za tafsiri yamekuwa ya kushangaza, na sasa mara nyingi hutupa tafsiri sahihi au sahihi kabisa (na mara chache kabisa kibwagizo), lakini tahadhari inapaswa kuchukuliwa, kama bado inaweza kuwa imepotea vibaya.

source: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
reference: Mojawapo ya programu maarufu sana katika kategoria hii ni Google Translate, ambayo huruhusu utafsiri nje ya mtandao baada ya kupakua data ya lugha inayotakikana.
hypothesis: Moja ya programu maarufu katika jamii hii ni Google Translate, ambayo inaruhusu tafsiri ya kibinafsi baada ya kupakua data ya lugha iliyochaguliwa.

source: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.
reference: Kutumia programu za kuabiri za GPS kwenye rununu yako kunaweza kuwa njia rahisi na bora ya kuabiri ukiwa nje ya nchi yako.
hypothesis: Kwa kutumia programu za GPS navigation kwenye simu yako ya mkononi inaweza kuwa njia rahisi na yenye urahisi zaidi ya kuelekea wakati uko nje ya nchi yako.

source: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.
reference: Inaweza kuokoa pesa badala ya kununua ramani mpya za GPS, au kifaa cha GPS kinachojisimamia au kukodisha kimoja kutoka kwa kampuni ya kukodisha magari.
hypothesis: Inaweza kuokoa fedha juu ya kununua ramani mpya kwa GPS, au kifaa GPS standalone au kukodisha moja kutoka kampuni ya kukodisha gari.

source: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.
reference: Ikiwa huna muunganisho wa data kwa simu yako, au ikiwa mbali na masafa, utendakazi wake utakwazika au hautakuwepo.
hypothesis: Kama huna uhusiano wa data kwa simu yako, au wakati ni nje ya mbalimbali, utendaji wao unaweza kuwa mdogo au haiwezekani.

source: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.
reference: Kila duka la karibu limejawa na aina nyingi za kukanganya za kadi za simu za kulipia kabla ambazo zinaweza kutumika katika simu za kulipia au simu za kawaida.
hypothesis: Kila duka la kona linajazwa na safu ya kushangaza ya kadi za simu za kabla za malipo ambazo zinaweza kutumika kutoka simu za kulipia au simu za kawaida.

source: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.
reference: Huku kadi nyingi zikiwa nzuri kwa kupiga simu kila mahali, nyingine ni maalumu kwa kutoa gharama za chini za kupiga simu kwa vikundi mahususi vya mataifa.
hypothesis: Wakati kadhaa zinazotumiwa kwa wito wowote, baadhi zina maalumu kwa kutoa kiwango cha wito cha kufavore kwa makundi maalumu ya nchi.

source: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.
reference: Ufikiaji wa huduma hizi mara nyingi ni kupitia nambari ya simu isiyolipishwa ambayo inaweza kupigwa kutoka simu nyingi bila malipo.
hypothesis: Ukubwa wa huduma hizi ni mara nyingi kupitia namba ya simu ya bure ambayo inaweza kupigwa kutoka simu nyingi bila malipo.

source: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
reference: Kanuni kuhusu upigaji picha za kawaida pia hutumika kwa kurekodi video, pengine hata zaidi.
hypothesis: Sheria zinazohusu picha za kawaida pia zinatumika kwa kurekodi video, labda zaidi.

source: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
reference: Ikiwa kupiga picha ya kitu tu hakuruhusiwi, basi hupaswi hata kufikiria kurekodi video yake.
hypothesis: Kama tu kuchukua picha ya kitu si kuruhusiwa, basi usiwe na mawazo ya kurekodi video ya hiyo kitu.

source: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
reference: Ikiwa unatumia ndege-roboti, angalia mapema ni nini unachoruhusiwa kuchukua filamu yake na ni vibali au leseni gani za ziada zinazohitajika.
hypothesis: Kama unatumia ndege ya drone, hakikisha mapema kabla ya kuchukua hatua yoyote kwamba unayo ruhusa ya kuchukua picha na kwa nini vyeti vingine vya leseni zinahitajika.

source: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
reference: Kurusha kidege-roboti karibu na uwanja wa ndege juu ya umati wa watu ni wazo mbaya karibu kila wakati, hata kama si haramu katika eneo lako.
hypothesis: Kuendesha ndege ya drone karibu na uwanja wa ndege au juu ya umati ni karibu daima ni wazo mbaya, hata kama si halali katika eneo lako.

source: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.
reference: Siku hizi usafiri wa ndege huhifadhiwa moja kwa moja mara chache kupitia kampuni ya ndege bila kwanza kutafuta na kulinganisha bei.
hypothesis: Leo, usafiri wa anga ni mara chache tu unachukuliwa moja kwa moja kupitia ndege bila kwanza kutafuta na kulinganisha bei.

source: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.
reference: Wakati mwingine safari moja inaweza kuwa na bei zinazotofautiana sana katika wajumuishaji tofauti na ina faida kulinganisha matokeo ya utafutaji na pia kuangalia tovuti ya kampuni ya ndege yenyewe kabla ya kuhifadhi.
hypothesis: Wakati mwingine, ndege sawa inaweza kuwa na bei tofauti sana kwenye agregators mbalimbali, na ni muhimu kulinganisha matokeo ya utafutaji na pia kuangalia tovuti ya ndege kabla ya booking.

source: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.
reference: Wakati huenda usihitaji visa kwa ziara fupi katika nchi fulani kama mtalii au kwa biashara, kwenda huko kama mwanafunzi wa kimataifa kwa jumla kunahitaji kukaa kwa muda mrefu kuliko kwenda huko kama mtalii wa kawaida tu.
hypothesis: Wakati unaweza kutokuwa na haja ya visa kwa ziara fupi katika baadhi ya nchi kama mgeni au kwa biashara, kwenda huko kama mwanafunzi wa kimataifa kwa ujumla inahitaji kukaa kwa muda mrefu kuliko kwenda huko kama mgeni wa kawaida.

source: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.
reference: Kwa ujumla, kukaa kwenye nchi ya kigeni kwa muda mrefu zaidi kunahitaji upate visa mapema.
hypothesis: Kwa ujumla, kukaa katika nchi yoyote ya kigeni kwa muda mrefu itahitaji kwamba utapata visa mapema.

source: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.
reference: Kwa jumla visa za wanafunzi huwa na mahitaji na utaratibu wa maombi tofauti na visa za kawaida za kitalii au kibiashara.
hypothesis: Visa za wanafunzi kwa ujumla zina mahitaji tofauti na taratibu za maombi tofauti na visa za utalii au biashara.

source: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.
reference: Kwa nchi nyingi, utahitaji barua ya ofa kutoka kwa taasisi ambayo unataka kusomea, na pia ushahidi wa pesa za kujisaidia kwa angalau mwaka wa kwanza wa kozi yako.
hypothesis: Kwa nchi nyingi, utahitaji barua ya kibali kutoka kwa taasisi unayotaka kujifunza, na pia ushahidi wa fedha za kutosha kwa mwaka wa kwanza wa kozi yako.

source: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
reference: Angalia katika taasisi, vilevile idara ya uhamiaji ya nchi ambako unahitaji kusomea kwa mahitaji ya kina.
hypothesis: Angalia na taasisi, pamoja na idara ya uhamiaji ya nchi unayotaka kujifunza kwa mahitaji ya kina.

source: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.
reference: Isipokuwa kama wewe ni mwanadiplomasia, kufanya kazi ughaibuni kwa jumla humaanisha kwamba utalazimika kufaili ushuru wa mapato nchini uliko.
hypothesis: Kama siyo balozi, kazi nje ya nchi kwa kawaida inamaanisha kwamba utahitaji kufungua kodi ya mapato katika nchi ambako unafanya kazi.

source: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.
reference: Ushuru wa mapato huundwa kwa njia tofauti katika nchi tofauti, na viwango na vikundi vya ushuru hutofautiana pakubwa toka nchi moja hadi nyingine.
hypothesis: Kodi ya mapato hutofautiana katika nchi mbalimbali, na viwango vya kodi na vikundi vya kodi hutofautiana sana kutoka nchi moja hadi nyingine.

source: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.
reference: Katika baadhi ya nchi za shirikisho, kama vile Marekani na Kanada, ushuru wa mapato hutozwa katika ngazi ya shirikisho na pia ngazi ya ndani, kwa hivyo viwango na vikundi vinaweza kutofautiana toka eneo hadi eneo.
hypothesis: Katika baadhi ya nchi za fedha, kama vile Marekani na Canada, kodi ya mapato inalipwa kwa ngazi ya fedha na kwa ngazi ya mitaa, hivyo viwango na vikundi vinaweza kutofautiana kutoka eneo hadi eneo.

source: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.
reference: Wakati kuangaliwa kwa uhamiaji kawaida haupo au ni urasmi ukifika katika nchi yako, udhibiti wa forodha unaweza kuwa shida.
hypothesis: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa uhamiaji ni kawaida au utaratibu wa kawaida wakati wa kuwasili kwa nyumbani, udhibiti wa kodi unaweza kuwa tatizo.

source: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.
reference: Hakikisha unajua kile unachoweza na hauwezi kuleta kisha kutangaza kitu chochote juu ya mipaka ya kisheria.
hypothesis: Kuhakikisha kwamba unajua nini unaweza na usiweze kuleta na kueleza kitu chochote juu ya mipaka ya kisheria.

source: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.
reference: Njia ilio rahisi kuanza biashara ya uandishi wa usafiri ni kuonyeshana ujuzi wako kwenye tovuti ya blogu ya usafiri iliyo imara.
hypothesis: Ukubwa wa kuanza katika biashara ya kuandika usafiri ni kuboresha ujuzi wako kwenye tovuti ya blogu ya usafiri iliyopo.

source: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.
reference: Unaporidhika na umbizo na uhariri kwenye wavuti, basi baadaye, labda utaunda tovuti yako mwenyewe.
hypothesis: Baada ya kuwa na ujuzi wa kutosha na usanidi wa mtandao na usanidi wa maandishi, basi baadaye, unaweza kuanza kujenga tovuti yako mwenyewe.

source: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.
reference: Kujitolea wakati wa kusafiri ni njia nzuri ya kuleta mabadiliko lakini si kuhusu utoaji tu.
hypothesis: Kujitolea wakati wa kusafiri ni njia nzuri ya kufanya tofauti, lakini siyo tu kuhusu kutoa.

source: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.
reference: Kuishi na kujitolea katika nchi ya kigeni ni njia bora ya kupata kujua utamaduni mpya, kukutana na watu wapya, kujifunza juu yako mwenyewe, kupata hisia za mtazamo na hata kupata ujuzi mpya.
hypothesis: Kuishi na kujitolea katika nchi ya kigeni ni njia nzuri ya kujifunza utamaduni tofauti, kukutana na watu wapya, kujifunza kuhusu wewe mwenyewe, kupata maoni ya mtazamo na hata kupata ujuzi mpya.

source: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.
reference: Pia inaweza kuwa njia bora ya kupanua bajeti ili kuwezesha kukaa mahali kwa muda mrefu kwani kazi nyingi za kujitolea hutoa vyumba na malazi na baadhi hulipa mshahara kidogo.
hypothesis: Inaweza pia kuwa njia nzuri ya kuzidisha bajeti ili kuruhusu kukaa mahali kwa muda mrefu zaidi, tangu kazi nyingi za kujitolea zinatoa malazi na chakula, na baadhi zinatoa mshahara mdogo.

source: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.
reference: Maharamia wa Skandinavia walitumia njia za majini za Kirusi kufika kwenye Bahari Nyeusi na Bahari ya Kaspi. Sehemu za njia hizo bado zinaweza kutumika. Angalia uwezekano wa kuhitaji vibali maalum, ambavyo huenda ikawa vigumu kuvipata.
hypothesis: Waviking walitumia njia za maji za Urusi kufika Bahari Nyeusi na Bahari ya Kaspia. Sehemu za njia hizi zinaweza kutumiwa bado. Angalia uwezekano wa vibali maalum, ambavyo vinaweza kuwa vigumu kupata.

source: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.
reference: Mfereji kati ya Bahari Nyeupe na Baltic huunganisha Bahari kuu ya Atiki na Bahari ya Baltic, kupitia Ziwa Onega, Ziwa Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, mara nyingi kwa mito na maziwa.
hypothesis: Kanuni ya Bahari ya White-Baltic inayounganisha Bahari ya Arctic na Bahari ya Baltic, kupitia Ziwa Onega, Ziwa Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, zaidi kwa njia ya mto na ziwa.

source: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.
reference: Ziwa Onega limeunganishwa na Volga, kwa hivyo bado inawezekana kusafiri kutoka Bahari Caspian kupitia Urusi.
hypothesis: Ziwa Onega pia inaunganishwa na Volga, hivyo kuja kutoka Bahari ya Caspian kupitia Urusi bado inawezekana.

source: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.
reference: Kuwa na uhakika ya kwamba unapofika bandarini, kila kitu kitakuwa dhahiri. Utapatana na waombajilifti wa machua wengine na watashiriki habari nawewe.
hypothesis: Uwe na uhakika kwamba marina moja wewe hit kila kitu itakuwa wazi. Utapata wengine mashua hitchhikers na wao itakuwa kushiriki habari yako.

source: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.
reference: Kimsingi utakuwa unaweka matangazo kuhusu msaada wako, kutembea katika gati, kuongelesha watu wanaosafisha mashua zao, kujaribu kuwasiliana na mabaharia kwenye baa, na kadhalika.
hypothesis: Kwa kifupi utakuwa kuweka notices kutoa msaada wako, pacing docks, kufikia watu kusafisha yachts zao, kujaribu kufikia sailors katika bar, nk.

source: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.
reference: Jaribu kuongea na watu wengi iwezekanavyo. Baada ya muda mfupi kila mtu atakujua na watakutolea vidokezo kuhusu ni boti ipi inayotafuta mtu.
hypothesis: Jaribu kuzungumza na watu wengi iwezekanavyo. Baada ya muda watu wote watajua wewe na watakuambia habari kuhusu boti ambayo inatafuta mtu.

source: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.
reference: Unafaa kuchagua kampuni ya Usafiri wa Mara Nyingi katika muungano kwa makini.
hypothesis: Unapaswa kuchagua ndege yako ya mara kwa mara kwa umoja kwa makini.

source: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.
reference: Ingawa unaweza kudhani ni bora zaidi kujiunga na kampuni ya ndege unayotumia zaidi, unapaswa kujua kuwa marupurupu yanayotolewa mara nyingi ni tofauti na pointi za usafiri wa mara kwa mara huenda zikawa karimu zaidi chini ya kampuni tofauti katika muungano mmoja.
hypothesis: Ingawa unaweza kudhani ni intuitive kujiunga na ndege ambayo unafanya safari nyingi, unapaswa kutambua kwamba haki zinazotolewa mara nyingi ni tofauti na pointi za mara kwa mara zinaweza kuwa za kifalme chini ya ndege tofauti katika muungano huo.
